name: Sandon
tagline: We hand-forge things that stay in a home for decades
niche: Artistic forge: grills, fireplaces, railings and décor

listing.description: A website for a blacksmith, an artistic forging workshop or a maker of grills and fireplaces. A glowing forge with sparks on the first screen, a product catalogue with “from” prices, steps shown as a scale of heat colours and a form to book a measurer.

seo.title: Sandon — artistic forging in Tashkent: grills and fireplaces
seo.description: Sandon forge hand-makes grills, fireplace sets, railings, beds and décor to your sketch. Free measuring, from 10 days, 5-year warranty on welds.
seo.answer: Sandon is an artistic forge at 24 Beshyogoch St. in Tashkent, open Monday to Saturday, 9:00–19:00. A hand-forged grill starts at 3,900,000 UZS, a fireplace set at 1,800,000 UZS, railings at 950,000 UZS per running metre. Measuring and sketch are free, making takes from 10 days, welds carry a 5-year warranty.

sections.title: Sandon
sections.subtitle: Hand-forged grills, fireplaces, railings and décor. We draw the sketch with you, forge it in the fire and install it at your home — no catalogue templates.

sections.label: The workshop
sections.title: Metal that remembers the hammer
sections.text: Sandon is one forge, two anvils and four smiths in a courtyard on Beshyogoch. We don’t weld pieces from ready-made stamped parts: every scroll, leaf and spike is drawn out of the bar by hand. That is why we never make two identical grills — and that is exactly why people come to us. Before we start, we visit, measure, draw a full-size sketch and agree on every detail.

sections.label: Catalogue
sections.title: What we forge
sections.intro: Prices are for a typical size. We give the final figure after measuring and sketching: it depends on length, metal thickness and the number of hand-forged elements.

items.title: Hand-forged grill
items.text: Steel 4 mm, removable grate, log shelf, optional rain roof.

items.title: Kazan stove & grill set
items.text: Grill, kazan stove and worktop in one frame for the yard.

items.title: Fireplace set and screen
items.text: Poker, shovel, tongs, stand and spark screen in one design.

items.title: Stair railings
items.text: For stairs, balconies and terraces, with a wooden or metal handrail.

items.title: Forged bed
items.text: A headboard in your pattern, reinforced slats for any mattress.

items.title: Lanterns and outdoor lights
items.text: Wall-mounted and post lanterns for LED bulbs, with frosted glass.

items.title: “Grapevine” grill
items.text: Vines and leaves on the sides, a canopy roof and a kazan shelf.

items.title: Three-storey railing
items.text: 18 running metres, a walnut handrail, scrolls set to the architect’s sketch.

items.title: “Peacock” fire screen
items.text: A tail of 42 forged feathers with a bronze-like patina.

items.title: Lanterns for a teahouse
items.text: Twelve lanterns with an islimi pattern and warm light.

items.title: Measuring
items.text: We come on a day that suits you, measure and check how the piece will fit. Free within Tashkent.

items.title: Sketch
items.text: We draw it full size, show sample elements and fix the price.

items.title: Forging
items.text: Every element is made in the fire and on the anvil. You are welcome to come and watch.

items.title: Finishing
items.text: Sandblasting, primer and powder coat or an antique patina.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We deliver, install and clean up after ourselves. Welds carry a 5-year warranty.

items.quote: The grill is in its third season with not a spot of rust. The neighbours have already asked for the forge’s number.
items.author: Sherzod

items.quote: We brought a photo of European railings — they made them better than the photo and fitted them to our crooked stairs.
items.author: Nargiza

items.quote: They were honest about timing: 14 days. They finished in 13 and installed everything themselves.
items.author: Bakhtiyor

items.q: How much is a forged grill?
items.a: A hand-forged grill starts at 3,900,000 UZS for a typical 8-skewer size. The price grows with length, steel thickness and the number of hand-made elements; we quote the exact sum after the sketch.
From 10 days for a grill or fireplace set, 3–5 weeks for railings and large orders. We fix the deadline in the contract.

items.q: Can you make it to my drawing?
items.a: Yes, most orders start that way: with a photo, a drawing or an idea. We develop the sketch into a drawing and show sample elements.
Before painting we sandblast and prime the metal, then apply powder coat. Welds carry a 5-year warranty.
Yes, across Tashkent region. Measuring and delivery outside the city are charged separately; we tell you the amount in advance.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Come to the forge
sections.text: Leave a request — a smith will call back within an hour to arrange a free measuring visit.
